title: Incident support of a block choice
statement: Given six successive choices of pairwise disjoint subsets of size $d$ from an $n$-element set, and a vertex $v$ of the complete graph on four vertices, define its incident support to be the union of the chosen subsets indexed by edges incident to $v$.
